Hi Rob,

You haven't missed an email. The return label for the two Thor P2s hasn't gone out yet. The return on order Shop···· needs the team to sign off before I can create the prepaid label. I've passed it to them along with everything they need.

The team is offline for the weekend. They pick this up Monday at 10am ET and will email the label to (email hidden) Your return reference will be Shop····. Please keep both boxes sealed until then, and don't pay to ship them yourself.

Your KBOX return is separate and you can send it now. Use the prepaid UPS label from November 11 (tracking ····) and write Shop···· on the box.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

---

Notes for you (not part of the email):
- **Label is blocked:** I couldn't create the Thor P2 return label. The order doesn't have the `rma-approved` tag, and the return tool won't run without it.
- **Flag raised:** I flagged it as "other" so the ticket stays open. This is the same request he made in chat earlier today. It includes his still-open question about getting a 40T instead of the KBOX.
- **Ready once approved:** I checked the return and nothing stands in the way. There are no disputes on any of his orders. The return reference will be Shop····, with a USPS Ground Advantage label for about CA$20.69 from (address hidden) to the Chattanooga warehouse. After approval, `return_order.py create --confirmed` will finish it.
- **KBOX return:** His KBOX return is still "Awaiting Arrival", so we haven't received the unit yet.
